# Muhammet Mert Erdoğan
Mechanical Engineer | Design, Analysis and Manufacturing
Istanbul, Türkiye

## About
I am interested not in one corner of mechanical engineering but in the whole path a product takes from idea to field. In my internships I worked across design, machining, assembly lines and on-site troubleshooting. I want to contribute to any team as an engineer who designs with manufacturing in mind and approaches manufacturing with design logic.

## Education
- Istanbul University-Cerrahpaşa, Institute of Graduate Studies - MSc in Mechanical Engineering (Thesis), Sep 2026 - present
- Istanbul University-Cerrahpaşa, Faculty of Engineering - BSc in Mechanical Engineering (30% English-medium), Sep 2021 - Jul 2026

## Experience
- FESTO - Intern (Aug 2025 - Sep 2025): Traced mechanical, pneumatic, electrical and software faults in an out-of-service robotic system through cross-disciplinary root cause analysis, implemented the fixes on site and recommissioned it.
- BEKO - Manufacturing Intern (Jul 2025 - Aug 2025): Found the loss sources at 5 critical stations that lowered assembly line efficiency through waste and root cause analysis; prepared and presented 2 improvement proposals with R&D and Production.
- MIDAS MAKİNA SANAYİ - Design Intern (Aug 2024 - Sep 2024): Revised 3D models of existing parts in SolidWorks per customer requests; prepared manufacturing drawings to dimensioning and tolerancing standards.
- YILMAZ REDÜKTÖR - Workshop Intern (Jul 2024): Observed CNC turning, milling, heat treatment and grinding on the gearbox production line; reviewed gear tolerances and quality control protocols.

## Projects
- Capstone Project - Beko (NDA), Oct 2025 - Jul 2026: Converted a metal component into an injection-moulded engineering plastic part; validated with topology optimisation and static FEA.
- Design Project - Mercedes-Benz Türk (NDA), Oct 2025 - Jul 2026: Ergonomic luggage loading system; validated with static and modal FEA.
- İÜC Racing - Formula Student, Powertrain Team, Sep 2023 - Jul 2026: Designed the chain guard in SolidWorks, verified with static analysis in ANSYS; 15% weight reduction by revising the bracket design.
- TEKNOFEST - UAV Landing Gear, Aug 2024 - Aug 2025: Parametric SolidWorks model, optimised with static FEA in ANSYS; FDM-printed parts (PLA, ABS, ASA) 50% below the weight target.
- Nuclear Reactor Pressure Vessel - Stress Analysis, Oct 2024 - Feb 2025: Analytical stress calculations verified against an ANSYS FEA model with < 3.2% deviation; study including elastic-plastic analysis (Ramberg-Osgood) being prepared for journal publication.
- Defect Prediction in Steel Production with Machine Learning, Feb 2025 - Jun 2025: Random Forest and Gradient Boosting classification in R; 91.3% accuracy.

## Skills
- Software: SolidWorks (CSWP), ANSYS Mechanical, AutoCAD, MS Excel, R, MATLAB/Simulink, Fusion 360, Siemens NX, CATIA
- Expertise: finite element analysis (static, modal, elastic-plastic), topology optimisation, solid modelling and parametric design, sheet metal design, design for injection moulding, technical drawing and tolerancing (GD&T), design for manufacturability (DFM), root cause analysis (RCA), lean manufacturing, pneumatic systems troubleshooting, machining processes, additive manufacturing / FDM 3D printing
- Languages: Turkish (native), English (C1)

## Certificates and training

- UAV Design and Build Training - TEİ Aviation Engine Schools
- McKinsey & Company Forward Program

- İÜC Machinery and Technologies Club - Member (Sep 2023 - Jul 2026)

Interests: 3D printing and prototyping, woodcarving, hiking
